blocks.html: Robinsons Malls, the first mall to bring government services in one roof, offers more than just ease and convenience in processing requirements and government-related documents; it also brings rewarding experiences to its patrons with its Independence Day Blow-Out Raffle Promo. One hundred (100) Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center (RMLPC) customers shall be given the chance to win free groceries worth P5,000.000 courtesy of Robinsons Supermarket. To qualify, customers shall present to the designated promo booth their proof of transaction with any of the government agencies within the 15 participating RMLPC at Robinsons Galleria Ortigas, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Place Antiplo, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Place Iloilo, Robinsons Place Bacolod, Robinsons Place GenSan, and Robinsons Place Butuan. Transaction with government agency should be from June 9-30. Winners will be drawn on July 6. Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center (RMLPC) is a public service program of Robinsons Malls. At present, there are 28 RMLPCs nationwide housing 19 government agencies such as Bureau of Immigration, Department of Foreign Affairs, Department of Trade & Industry, Department of Tourism, Professional Regulations Commission, Land Registration Authority, Land Transportation Office, National Bureau of Investigation, Philippine Health Insurance, Philippine Postal Corporation, Home Development Mutual Fund (Pag-Ibig), Government Service Insurance System, Securities and Exchange Commission, Social Security System, Technical Education and Skills Development Authority, Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Authority, Philippine Overseas Employment Administration, Overseas Workers Welfare Administration and Commission on Elections. Know more about the promo mechanics and be updated with upcoming events by visiting www.robinsonsmalls.com or following Robinsons Malls at Facebook: www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls; Twitter: @RobinsonsMalls; and Instagram: @robinsonsmallsofficial.
